title: Fixed-degree ordinary module-section vanishing passes to filtered-colimit hulls
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and let Λ be any commutative condensed ring. Use internal Λ_X-modules on the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and their ordinary uncompleted derived sections to abelian groups [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-sfb-condensed-module-sections]. Let P be any property of these modules, and q any integer. Suppose H^q(RΓ(X,N[0]))=0 for every N satisfying P. Then the same vanishing holds for any M which admits a small filtered ambient colimit presentation by modules satisfying P [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], equivalently ObjectProperty.ind.{u+1} P M. Index categories are small in universe u+1, where X is a Scheme.{u}. No degree bound on q, coefficient restrictions, Noetherianity, or lift of the module diagram to presentations is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), global sections clause, applied to degree-zero module complexes.

proof.text: Choose the given filtered module presentation, and apply the single-complex functor in degree zero. Each complex is strictly supported in degrees at least zero, so good truncation at zero is isomorphic to the original complex. The single-complex functor preserves colimits. Thus the vertex of the continuity cocone is isomorphic to the single complex on M.

Apply bounded-below filtered continuity of ordinary module-derived global sections with common lower bound zero. It identifies the target cohomology with the colimit of the degree-q cohomology groups of the given modules.
Each group in this last diagram is zero by hypothesis. A colimit of a zero diagram is zero. Transport zero-ness through the continuity isomorphism and the single-complex colimit identification.

theorem condensedModuleSections_ind_isZero
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (P : ObjectProperty
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))
    (q : ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ M, P M → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))))
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : P.ind.{u + 1} M) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
